sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Ashina Depths is a cavernous area underneath Ashina Castle. Mibu Village can be accessed through here.
Sculptor's Idol:
- Poison Pool
- Guardian Ape's Burrow
- Hidden Forest
- Mibu Village
- Water Mill
- Wedding Cave Door

sections.heading: Poison Pool
sections.text:
An underground cavern with a poison pool, filled with large Buddha statues. Inhabited by Snake Eye followers and Snake Eyes Shirahagi. The exit of the Sunken Valley Passage shrine leads back to the poison pool.

Stopping between the two of them and jumping up the cliff, Wolf will be able to wall jump up to the top of a statue, where he will find the prayer bead.

sections.heading: Mibu Village
sections.text:
The village lays deep within Ashina Depths and is shrouded in a dense fog. The denizens of the village are ghastly in appearance.
At one time, the forests of pine trees in the area always appeared to be smoldering. This acted as a landmark to find one's way to the village. In time though, the villagers came to loathe the flames and destroyed the trees. Some defended the flame though, and were equally loathed.
After defeating Corrupted Monk, Nightjar apparitions appear in Mibu Village near the plantation, and near the entrance of the village.
